description: This file defines the EmbeddedFile class used for representing embedded files within PDF documents in the MigraDoc library. It includes properties for file name and path, serialization logic, and internal value handling.

classes.name: EmbeddedFile
classes.description: Represents an embedded file in a PDF document, with properties for file name and path, and serialization capabilities.

methods.name: EmbeddedFile
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the embedded file object.

methods.name: EmbeddedFile
methods.description: Constructor that initializes embedded file with a name and path.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the embedded file object into a DDL-like format.

methods.name: Meta
methods.description: Returns the meta-object information for EmbeddedFile class.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets or sets the name used to refer to and entitle the embedded file.

properties.name: Path
properties.description: Gets or sets the path to the file to embed.

properties.name: Values
properties.description: Provides access to internal nullable values for Name and Path.

inner_classes.name: EmbeddedFileValues
inner_classes.description: Holds internal nullable properties for EmbeddedFile, including Name and Path.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the EmbeddedFile object into a textual representation suitable for DDL.
